script:
He Xiaodi
You were once an excellent tomb raider. Twenty years ago, you and your five sworn brothers formed a tomb raiding gang when you were only fifteen years old. Your skills were crude and you lacked experience, but your five brothers each had their specialties and always took care of you. Together you raided several small tombs, but never made much money.
Nineteen years ago, in 1916, a boss surnamed Hai found your group. He claimed to have discovered a large tomb in the Changbai Mountains, believing it contained many treasures. Impressed by your brothers' skills, he wanted to hire you to raid the tomb, promising substantial payment and a fifty-fifty split of whatever artifacts you brought out. Your brother who specialized in feng shui had also detected a large tomb in Changbai Mountains but lacked the precise skills to locate it. Surprisingly, Boss Hai had ventured into the mountains alone and actually found it. After discussion, you decided to cooperate with Boss Hai to raid this tomb.
You stayed overnight in a small village at the mountain's base before hastily entering the mountains, accompanied by Boss Hai and his brother. When you reached the tomb site, everyone was excited - it appeared to be an ancient nobleman's tomb of considerable age. Boss Hai and his brother claimed their skills weren't good enough and might hold you back, so they asked you to go down alone. Thinking about the imminent wealth and good life ahead, you brothers were all full of energy.
However, after you dug the tunnel and went down, you accidentally triggered a mechanism in the tomb. In the panic, your eldest brother pushed you away, and you hit your head on the wall and lost consciousness.
When you woke up, you found yourself separated from the others by fallen stones. Your brothers were nowhere to be found. You got lost in the tomb and wandered for several days before finally finding the tunnel you had dug. You returned to the surface and met Boss Hai, who told you he hadn't seen your other brothers return. You both went back into the tomb along another route to search, and soon discovered the bodies of your five brothers. Boss Hai said they appeared to have triggered a powerful mechanism in the tomb. You felt immense grief and didn't think to carefully examine their wounds. Boss Hai helped you hastily bury your brothers, and then you descended the mountain.
On the way, you remembered that Boss Hai's brother was missing. He told you his brother had gone down the mountain ahead to wait for them. He said the tomb's mechanisms seemed very powerful, beyond even your abilities to handle, so he decided to abandon the tomb and return later with experts. He promised to pay you the full hiring fee for all six of you and repeatedly asked you to accept his condolences. You couldn't help but feel that Boss Hai was truly a righteous good man. You returned to the village, met Boss Hai's brother and the three horses he had hired, then set off on the return journey.
After returning to the city, having lost your team, you had no business. Other tomb raider gangs refused to accept you, considering you too young and unskilled. You even faced pursuit by a group of unidentified men in black, but managed to escape by luck. Without any particular skills, you quickly spent the hiring fee Boss Hai had given you. Not daring to return to your original residence, you could only live under a false identity, barely surviving by selling manual labor.
You tried hard to forget everything that happened in Changbai Mountains, but a year later you accidentally heard that a batch of artifacts from an ancient Changbai Mountains tomb was being auctioned, with the seller's identity very mysterious. You vaguely felt those artifacts were the ones you were supposed to raid, but your brothers had all died inside - who had brought these things out? You suddenly thought of the assassination attempt you had faced and couldn't help connecting these two events. You began to suspect that your encounter in the tomb wasn't as simple as it seemed, and that Hai Bei might not be the great benefactor you had always believed him to be.
Carrying these doubts, you returned to Changbai Mountains and found the place where you had buried your brothers based on memory. Examining their wounds, you discovered they all had knife wounds in their chests, not like injuries from mechanisms. You also found a piece of torn cloth in your second brother's hand with the character "Hai" written crookedly on it. You suddenly realized your brothers hadn't died from mechanisms, but had been killed by the man surnamed Hai after they brought out the treasures! Those auctioned artifacts were what your brothers had brought out!
You returned to the city filled with hatred. Although you still couldn't figure out how Boss Hai and one other person had killed your five agile brothers, or how they had transported so many artifacts down the mountain, it no longer mattered. What mattered was that you were certain Boss Hai had killed your brothers, and you had to find him to avenge them.
Since that batch of artifacts was auctioned, there had been no news of Changbai Mountains treasures on the market, and Boss Hai from that year had also vanished without a trace. Over the years, you only heard about a small business owner named Hai Bei who did transportation business, but you didn't know the full name of the Boss Hai who had led you into the mountains, and had no opportunity to meet Hai Bei to confirm if they were the same person.
By chance in 1933, you heard that artifacts from Changbai Mountains had appeared on the market again, but in very small quantities - only one or two pieces occasionally. Not wanting to miss any opportunity, you began trying every means to investigate the seller of these artifacts, Yang Canghai. You investigated for two whole years before finally hearing rumors in 1935 that Yang Canghai seemed to have some unknown dealings with the Hai Bei you had previously suspected. You immediately connected this to the Changbai Mountains incident and became certain that Hai Bei was the enemy you had been seeking for twenty years.
You began preparing for revenge. You discovered that Hai Bei usually stayed secluded at home, and even when he went out, he was heavily guarded. You couldn't gather information about him from the Hai family. However, while chatting with Yang Canghai's subordinates, one casually mentioned that Yang Canghai went to the Peace Hotel every fifth day of each month. Through investigation, you learned that both Yang Canghai and Hai Bei had long-term rooms at the Peace Hotel, confirming this was their trading location. So in May 1935, you applied for and got a job as a waiter in the Peace Hotel's café.
Every fifth of the month, you paid close attention to the hotel's guests. You immediately recognized Hai Bei and noticed that every fourth of the month, he would bring a young woman and a secretary-like person to stay in rooms 1203 and 1202, leaving on the evening of the fifth. Having grasped Hai Bei's movements, you began plotting your murder plan.
[October 4th]
At 9:00 PM, as you were preparing to get off work, you saw the man and woman who had come with Hai Bei enter the café one after another. You thought this was the perfect opportunity to act since Hai Bei must be alone in his room. So you took the knife you had prepared, wandered around the café area a few times, and when the coffee machine area was finally empty, you sneakily made a cup of coffee, then went to the elevator and up to the twelfth floor. Looking at the clock in the elevator, you realized that after all this preparation, it was already 9:18.
At 9:20, you reached room 1203 and knocked on the door, but got no response. So you used your master key to open the door, put down the coffee, pushed open the bedroom door, and discovered Hai Bei was already lying dead on the floor. You were startled and quickly ran out, but bumped right into a cleaner (Jiang Zhong) at the door. You thought that if you were discovered, you'd be the first suspect. So you quickly said the room was inconvenient and asked him not to go in. At the same time, the door to room 1204 next door opened, a man came out, saw you both, and went back inside closing the door. After that, you hurriedly left.
acts_goal: Clear yourself of suspicion and catch the real killer.
